data.raw_text: Fung-wong has strengthened to a Category 4 major typhoon, with sustained winds of 130 mph. This large, strong typhoon is causing widespread impacts across northern and central Philippines, with heavy rainfall and gusty winds. The eyewall is battering areas like Catanduanes right now. Fung-wong is forecast to continue heading west-northwest and make landfall around Baler Bay on Sunday night (local time). Life-threatening winds, storm surge, landslides, and flooding are the main concerns. We hope everyone has sought shelter!

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Cyclone UWAN
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 09 November 2025(Sunday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Quezon, Laguna, Rizal and Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Nueva Ecija, Metro Manila, Cavite, Batangas, Bulacan(Angat, Balagtas, Baliuag, Bocaue, Bulakan, Bustos, Calumpit, Malolos, Meycauayan, San Jose del Monte, Guiguinto, Hagonoy, Marilao, Obando, Pandi, Paombong, Plaridel, Pulilan, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael, Santa Maria), Pampanga(Arayat, Candaba, San Luis, Santa Ana, San Simon, Apalit, Magalang, Mexico, San Fernando, Santo Tomas, Minalin, Macabebe, Masantol, Bacolor) and Tarlac(San Manuel, Paniqui, Moncada, Anao, Ramos, Gerona, Pura, Victoria, Tarlac City, La Paz, Concepcion).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Zambales, Bataan, Tarlac(Bamban, Capas, Camiling, Mayantoc, San Clemente, San Jose, Santa Ignacia) and Pampanga(Floridablanca, Lubao, Sasmuan, Angeles, Mabalacat, Guagua, Porac, Santa Rita) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZISbP.
